shared_prompt: Children's picture book illustration, soft gouache and watercolor texture, warm afternoon sunlight from the upper left, gentle shading, rounded friendly shapes, a single sunflower plant in the same terracotta clay pot, centered composition, plain background, no text, no watermark, no border.

stages.name: 种子
stages.prompt: Replace the plant with a single large striped sunflower seed half-buried in the dark soil. No stem, no leaves, no flower.

stages.name: 发芽
stages.prompt: Replace the plant with two small rounded cotyledon leaves on a very short pale-green stem. No true leaves, no bud, no flower.

stages.name: 幼苗
stages.prompt: Replace the plant with a young seedling: a slender stem about one third of the pot height with two pairs of small true leaves. No bud, no flower.

stages.name: 花苞
stages.prompt: Replace the plant with a tall stem and broad leaves topped by a single closed green bud with a tiny hint of yellow. No open petals.

stages.name: 开花
stages.prompt: Replace the flower with a half-open sunflower: only the outer ring of petals unfurled, the center still a tight green-yellow dome partly covered by sepals, clearly narrower and less open than the reference.

stages.name: 盛放
stages.prompt: A fully blooming sunflower with two layers of golden-yellow pointed petals and a large domed brown seed center. This image served as the style and pot reference for the other six stages.

stages.name: 结籽
stages.prompt: Transform the flower into a mature seed stage: a heavy dark seed head full of visible seeds, golden petals slightly drooping and deeper in colour, a few loose seeds falling.

processing: Removed the generated pale checkerboard background with a low-saturation, high-value mask, then a 5px alpha opening to drop isolated specks.
Detected the terracotta pot in each image and aligned every stage to the same pot box (382px wide, bottom edge y=983 on a 1024px canvas).
Cleared the model's bottom-right watermark area and the outer 6px frame.
Exported 1024px full WebP assets and 256px badge crops at quality 92; stage 0-2 badges zoom into the pot and young plant, stage 3-6 badges frame the bud or flower.
third_party: None. No textbook illustrations, trademarks, logos or character likenesses were supplied or reproduced.
note: AI output is used as project artwork. The image service's account terms and any local-law questions remain with the account holder; this record is provenance, not a legal clearance.
